goal: In scaffold/agent/pei_report.py add a short module-level docstring explaining PEI uses tokens as the primary cost measure

lines.content: PEI Report — client-facing Project Efficiency Index scorecard.
PEI uses tokens as the primary cost measure. All cost calculations are
derived from token counts × price table, not from dollar amounts returned
by providers. This ensures consistent, provider-agnostic cost tracking.
Reads .awos/ runtime data and produces a proof-of-value report:
Quality × Speed ÷ Tokens  (cost derived from token counts)

files.before_excerpt:
"""
PEI Report — client-facing Project Efficiency Index scorecard.

Reads .awos/ runtime data and produces a proof-of-value report:
  Quality × Speed ÷ Tokens  (cost derived from token counts)

Usage:
    from pei_report import PEIReport
    report = PEIReport(store_path=".awos", project_name="My Repo")
    report.print_summary()
    report.write_html("reports/pei_report.html")
"""
